'''Alex Olivo''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 4th at [[2001 Martin-Con]] in August 2001, according to Martin Warlick's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2874">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-20-martin-con-01d2874/ martin-con-01], DeckTech (Martin "psycho_loser" Warlick, 20 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-20-martin-con-01d2874/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
